question: A person who spends 52% of his monthly income is able to save ₹7,740 per month. His monthly expenses (in) are:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Savings** percentage = 100% − 52% = 48%.

Given 48% = ₹7,740.

**Expenses** = 52%.

Value of 52% = (7,740 ÷ 48) × 52 = 161.25 × 52 = ₹8,385.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,385.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Expenditure** = 52% of **Monthly Income**

**Savings** = ₹7,740

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48a18c32373fa24b247649e6d52805ccee5bd04d2694d8638298c122c7a566eb.png] 

⇒ Let **Monthly Income** be I.

⇒ **Savings** = **Income** − **Expenditure**

⇒ 48% of I = 7,740

⇒ (48/100) × I = 7,740

⇒ I = (7,740 × 100) ÷ 48

⇒ I = 16,125

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 52% of 16,125

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 0.52 × 16,125 = 8,385

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,385.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Formula

Total **Income** is always the sum of **Expenditure** and **Savings** (I = E + S).

Percentage Change

If income increases by x% and expenditure by y%, the new savings can be calculated using the **Base Change** method.

Ratio Method

Convert percentages to fractions to simplify: 52% = 13/25. If **Income** is 25 units, **Expense** is 13 units and **Savings** is 12 units.
